items.text: Patriots Wednesday injury report: NO PARTICIPATION: WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), TE Hunter Henry (foot), RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness).
items.why: Official Wednesday practice report from Patriots beat lists no participation for ankle/knee.
items.implication: Strengthens case AJ Brown misses or is heavily limited Week 9 vs GB; opponent King Kong loses key WR production.
items.opportunity: Monitor Friday designation; if OUT, lowers opponent floor significantly.
corroboration: Prior ETR report of lingering knee

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) limited at practice Wednesday
items.why: Limited participant on Wednesday; Rich Cimini reports still not full but trending toward playing Sunday per HC Glenn.
items.implication: Positive progress toward return; Braelon Allen usage could drop if Hall active and ramps up.
items.opportunity: If Hall plays, prioritize him over Allen in lineup decisions; monitor remaining practices.
corroboration: @RichCimini: still not full practice, trending toward playing Sunday
